_doc: Worked examples of the SRQL shape normalization defined in src/shape.rs (and warehouse_entity in src/coverage.rs). Asserted by the Rust unit tier (shape::tests::the_shared_normalization_examples_hold) AND by the Elixir port in elixir/web-ng/test/support/srql_parity_shape.ex (warehouse_query_inventory_test.exs), so the two implementations cannot drift. `entities` maps a spelling to its canonical warehouse entity, or null when the warehouse does not serve it; the Elixir test also checks each against ServiceRadar.Analytics.StarRocks.Readers.dataset_for_entity/1. In `shapes`, `entity` is the canonical warehouse entity (null when not warehouse-served), `chart` is whether the query is a chart/aggregate query, and `clauses`/`modifiers` are the normalized shape. Every query here is invented.
